**10. Portfolio Direction?**

**12. Commodities to Watch?**

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -15.94%) around the 20 complacency level, HYG/LQD spread with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +1.31%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +0.76%) near a 0.80 health threshold, and XLK/XLF cross to signal any growth/value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Materials, metals and select cyclicals showing strength while tech momentum is cooling — monitor 1W vs 1M divergences for escalation risk.
